newsitem.title: USA: Strober says faces class action.
newsitem.headline: Strober says faces class action.

text.p: Strober Organization Inc said Thursday that it faces a class action lawsuit filed by a shareholder who alleges Strober's directors failed to properly market the company.
Strober said it believes the complaint is without merit and that it intends to vigorously defend against this claim.
Strober agreed on November 11 to to be acquired for $6 a share, or about $32 million. The acquisition is led by Fidelity Ventures Limited Partnership, a private venture capital investor.

In February 1996, the company issued a press release advising the general public that the company had retained an investment advisor to explore strategic alternatives in order to maximize stockholder value, including the possible merger or sale of the company.
Strober supplies building materials to professional contractors in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut and Pennsylvania.
